_comment: THE UPSTREAM LibreOffice THIS PROJECT PATCHES. This file is the DECLARATION;
libreoffice/ is a gitignored working tree and is not evidence of anything.
Two things depend on this being correct and neither tolerates a guess:
1. Reproducibility -- engine/patches/*.patch apply to THIS commit. A different
upstream may apply cleanly and still produce different bytes.
2. Licence compliance -- MPL-2.0 / LGPLv3+ require Corresponding Source for the
soffice.wasm we convey. 'Corresponding' means THIS commit plus our patches;
naming the wrong one does not discharge the obligation. See
To move to a new upstream: update commit/version/branch/describe/commit_date
together, re-apply the patch series, and rebuild. Do not edit one field alone.
declared_from: the libreoffice/ tree in the main checkout that produced the current web/modules/ artifacts
